text:
Predicates:
Mammal(x) ::: x is a mammal.
HaveTeeth(x) ::: x has teeth.
Premises:
∃x (Mammal(x) ∧ HaveTeeth(x)) ::: Some mammals have teeth.
¬HaveTeeth(platypus) ::: Platypus have no teeth.
Mammal(platypus) ::: Platypus are mammals.
HaveTeeth(human) ::: Humans have teeth.
Conclusion:
Mammal(human) ::: Humans are mammals.
